title: Nice but not quite sturdy
text:
Nice but not quite sturdy. So this is very attractive. It looks nice. I like that it fits in the corner. It is a nice wood.

The reason I gave it a middling review was because it is just not sturdy enough. Someone may fall if they are not used to it. Once you get used to it, you can be careful and not fall (we are going to keep it) but we just did have issues with it. I think it can be someone people can use, but you do have to be careful.
